description: Baseline benchmark setup ran, but product build check failed on missing STDERR_FILENO include in existing src/agent.cpp.

asi.hypothesis: Establish a representative memory operations baseline before optimizing.
asi.rollback_reason: Correctness checks failed because building the full pi-lite target now reports STDERR_FILENO undeclared in src/agent.cpp.
asi.next_action_hint: Add the missing unistd include or otherwise restore product build, then rerun the baseline setup.

description: First passing memory benchmark baseline plus benchmark/check infrastructure and STDERR_FILENO build fix.

asi.hypothesis: Create a stable representative benchmark and fix the product build so future memory optimizations have correctness backpressure.
asi.benchmark_shape: 1000 seeded memories, 96 searches, 48 prompt_context retrievals, 32 steady saves, 32 list calls, 5-trial median.
asi.build_fix: Added <unistd.h> to src/agent.cpp for STDERR_FILENO on POSIX builds.

description: Avoid vector/metadata materialization for list/search and partial-sort top-k; list got faster but search/save worsened overall.

asi.hypothesis: Skipping vector allocation and metadata JSON parsing in list/search would reduce steady-state retrieval latency.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary total_us regressed by ~6.5%; direct BLOB scoring plus per-row category parsing and extra code path made search/prompt/save slower despite list_us dropping from ~210k to ~70k.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the list-specific projection idea separate; for search focus on category parsing, prepared statements, or avoiding repeated full scans rather than BLOB direct scoring as implemented.
asi.phase_learning: list projection is promising, search direct blob scoring is not in this form.

description: Split list into lightweight projection while keeping search full-record scan; list improved but search/save regressed badly.

asi.hypothesis: Use a lightweight SELECT for public list while keeping search semantics with the original full record scan.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary total_us regressed ~20%; duplicating search's SQL path rather than using list likely changed planner/cache behavior and hurt dominant search/save phases, swamping list gains.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not split search/list this way. Try optimizing the existing shared list path in-place, or address save/search scan count with SQL hash exact dedupe before vector near-duplicate scan.
asi.surprise: Even semantically similar full-record search path was much slower than search calling list(), suggesting benchmark is sensitive to extra code/prepare path or noise; confirm with simpler changes.
